title: Has anyone replicated Saltline?
author: Forcio
selftext:
I have had Fable 5.2 run for about 8 hours to work on a zombie shooter. No assets just the libraries it would need for three.js.

It looked nothing like what Felix Rieseberg managed to create in 8 hours with his game Saltline.

All I have is a terrible slice of a game and 60% of my fable 5.2 tokens gone for this week.

Has anyone tried replicating it?

comments.author: Recoil42
comments.body: What was your prompt and what level of Claude sub do you have?

replies.author: Forcio
replies.body:
Claude Max and 
"You know, you should also build me a zombie FPS. Insanely detailed quality pls, something that looks visually like it can keep up with AAA. Make it small in scope (like a tiny level) but otherwise impressive photorealistic graphics".

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body: Interesting. What hardware are you on? Did you build via cloud or locally?

comments.author: Affectionate_Tie357
comments.body: Never trust these advertisements. It may be done with ai but not a single prompt and not without API costs that a regular person can't afford

comments.author: RyuGamer97
comments.body: Me paso lo mismo varios intentos, prompts refinados y simplemente nada que refleje el modelo

comments.author: GCC_GicaCamelCase
comments.body: We need to come to terms that these companies will astroturf us whenever they release a new model so we get hyped and spend money. The guy who made the game most likely either put a lot more effort into it, or has a lot of advanced infra around it. Ngl, I also felt into the trap and wasted my credits. It's good, but ye...

comments.author: selfish_meme
comments.body: Get Fable to build you a prompt to build a high realism single level web based zombie game, then use that prompt to build the game

replies.author: Bavariasnaps
replies.body: First get Fable for a prompt about how correctly to ask Fable for a prompt to build a high realism single level web based zombie game, then use that prompt to build the game

replies.author: selfish_meme
replies.body: Ask fable how get fable to ask fable to make a prompt for fable to build the game

replies.author: Bavariasnaps
replies.body:
>**The last comment is a joke, not an idea.** selfish\_meme’s “ask Fable how to get Fable to ask Fable to make a prompt” is just escalating the recursion from the comment above it (the Bavariasnaps one), which was itself mocking the first suggestion.  
  
A useful reply to OP would be: write a real spec (one meta-prompt level is fine for that), give it an asset source, make it look at its own screenshots, and work in checked stages.

Asked Fable if your comment is a good idea.

replies.author: selfish_meme
replies.body: I know it was a joke, but I have had good results doing just that, ask Claude to make a prompt to build such and such game, ask me a lot of questions about how I want it to look and play. The prompt Claude generated spit out a dungeon crawler overnight with 9 levels, many races, gameplay, story, I asked it to do no artwork at all but it still put music and sound effects in
